title: Ordinary finite-coefficient Chern classes
statement:
Use [def-pur-conventions] at finite coefficients $A=A_{E,n}$, with $n\geq1$. Write $H^m(T,A(j))$ for the ordinary pro-etale cohomology of [def-pur-support-cohomology] with full support $T$, and use the full-support cup product of [def-pur-supported-cup], with the canonical Tate-twist identifications of [def-pur-conventions]. Let $T$ be a separated finite-type $k$-scheme and let $F$ be a locally free $\mathcal O_T$-module of constant rank $r\geq0$ [def-amb-finite-locally-free-module].

For $r>0$, put $q:P=\mathbf P_T(F)\to T$ in the quotient convention [lem-pur-projective-bundle-tautological-geometry] and put $h=c_{1,A}(\mathcal O_P(1))$ [lem-pur-kummer-additivity]. Use the degree-$2r$, twist-$r$ cohomology instance of [thm-pur-projective-bundle-formula]:
$$\Phi_{F,r}:\bigoplus_{j=0}^{r-1}H^{2(r-j)}(T,A(r-j))\xrightarrow{\sim}H^{2r}(P,A(r)),\qquad (a_j)_j\longmapsto\sum_{j=0}^{r-1}q^*a_j\cup h^j.$$
Here $h^0=1$, and the powers and products are the full-support cup products just specified. Set $(a_0,\ldots,a_{r-1})=\Phi_{F,r}^{-1}(h^r)$, and for $1\leq i\leq r$ define
$$c_i(F):=(-1)^{i+1}a_{r-i}\in H^{2i}(T,A(i)).$$
Equivalently, these are the signed coefficients in
$$h^r-q^*c_1(F)\cup h^{r-1}+q^*c_2(F)\cup h^{r-2}-\cdots+(-1)^rq^*c_r(F)=0.$$
Set $c_0(F)=1\in H^0(T,A)$ and $c_i(F)=0\in H^{2i}(T,A(i))$ for $i>r$. For $r=0$ these conventions define all the classes without forming $\mathbf P(0)$. These are ordinary finite-coefficient Chern classes, defined without reference to a section, a supported Euler class, or a purity isomorphism.

Hypotheses hold: P is proper over a separated finite-type T, so it is separated and of finite type over k, which is the domain of Kummer additivity; projective-bundle formula with B=T, n=r-1. Phi is Hom(A_T(-r)[-2r],-) applied to the derived isomorphism, using p^* -| Rp_* and twist invertibility; its components are q^*a cup h^j (full-support cup, even degrees, no signs). The coefficients are therefore unique. Sign: c_i=(-1)^{i+1}a_{r-i} gives h^r-c_1h^{r-1}+...=0, which is Stacks' relation times (-1)^r. Tested r=0; r=1 (c_1 = Kummer c_1); r=2 trivial bundle over k (h^2=0, so c=0); r=2 split bundle (h-x_1)(h-x_2)=0, consistent with the flag formula. Empty T and non-field A are fine. Constant rank is all the citers use. No cycle (does not depend on the flag formula or the localized class). No duplicate in the DAG and no blueprint same_as (searched 'chern', 0FI5, main-20261015/20261017). No new nodes, no SGA, no tool_uses. No fixes.
